quandoUsar: Pricing page where the billing period (monthly or yearly) changes the values shown on the plans.
When the cheaper option carries a savings badge whose text changes when it is chosen (`badge` → `activeBadge`).
Prices that should roll to the new value without pushing what is next to them: use `BillingPrice`, exported by the same file.
quandoEvitar: Use `segmented-control` to toggle views or filters that are not a billing period and carry no badge.
Use `switch` for an on or off setting with immediate effect.
Use `plan-comparison` when you need the full plan comparison, not just the period selector.

teclado.acao: Selects the next option and moves focus to it; from the last it wraps to the first.
Selects the previous option; from the first it goes to the last.
Selects the first or last option.
Enters the group at the selected option and leaves it; the other options are outside the tab order.

acessibilidade: The group is a `role="radiogroup"` and each option a `<button role="radio">` with `aria-checked` and a roving tabindex.
`label` names the group and defaults to English (`Billing period`): pass the text in the page language.

The badge is part of the option name, so the screen reader announces label and badge together; in `BillingPrice` the old price comes out in a `<del>` and the current value has a text copy for screen readers.
movimento: A single thumb slides between options with a spring with no overshoot, taking the position and width of the chosen option.
The badge swaps text in place, in a box that already has the width of the longest text; in `BillingPrice` the digits roll to the new value and the old price (`was`) opens in width.
With “reduce motion” on, the thumb and digits jump into place and texts only fade.
responsivo: Labels and badges do not wrap (`white-space: nowrap`): on narrow screens, keep the texts short.
`BillingPrice` pushes the period to the line below when width runs short (`flex-wrap`).
notasIA: It is always controlled: `value` and `onValueChange` are required; without `options` it shows `Monthly` and `Yearly` with the `Save 20%` badge, in English.
The file also exports `BillingPrice` (`amount`, `currency`, `period`, `was`, `decimals`); `was` only shows struck through when it is greater than `amount`.
Depends on `animated-counter`; the active badge color comes from `--billing-accent` (default `--success`), which can be defined on any ancestor.
